relevant-context-over-erudition.idea: Reconstruct the environment before judging the text: where it was published, who reads it, what gets cut there. An absence of specifics may be caution rather than weakness.
relevant-context-over-erudition.indicator: First reaction is 'weak text' or 'no concrete examples'.
relevant-context-over-erudition.rule: If the author could not say it directly, read the edges, not the centre.

complex-client-not-traumatized.idea: Adapted defensive style (wants an instrument) vs decompensated vulnerability (wants depth).
complex-client-not-traumatized.indicator: Asks for a protocol, corrects wording toward simplicity, refuses to discuss feelings.
complex-client-not-traumatized.rule: Give a protocol; ask which decision would be made automatically if time ran out.

shadow-as-internal-corporation.idea: Turn a trait from a diagnosis into a function: which post it holds, what it does there, what it costs when absent.
shadow-as-internal-corporation.indicator: The client lists traits as flaws to be removed.
shadow-as-internal-corporation.rule: Return a table and a question, not a reassurance.

aesopian-as-choice.idea: Forced Aesopian language (risk) vs deliberate Aesopian language (precision: a whisper travels further than a shout).
aesopian-as-choice.indicator: The sharpest section was cut in the final version.
aesopian-as-choice.rule: Check whether the author ever wrote plainly, and what happened to those texts.

honest-limit-of-theory.idea: Name the gap instead of extending the theory to a smooth shape.
honest-limit-of-theory.indicator: The analysis needs a step for which there are neither data nor theory.
honest-limit-of-theory.rule: A direction can be clear while the timeline is not.

sovereign-ethics-vs-conformism.idea: Adaptive conformism (fear of rejection) vs sovereign pragmatism (own code with a stated boundary).
sovereign-ethics-vs-conformism.indicator: Selective rule-breaking that the person can justify.
sovereign-ethics-vs-conformism.rule: Ask under what conditions a rule is sufficient and under what conditions it is not.

anger-as-value-defense.idea: Projection vs value confrontation: anger can be a reaction to a profaned value, not a symptom.
anger-as-value-defense.indicator: The violated value can be stated in one sentence.
anger-as-value-defense.rule: Name the value, then the price of holding it.

snyatie-vs-umolchanie.idea: Sublation (the old thesis survives as the ground of the new one) vs forced silence (the topic became expensive).
snyatie-vs-umolchanie.indicator: A topic disappears after a political shift.
snyatie-vs-umolchanie.rule: Look for traces of the old thesis in examples, caveats and addressees.

aesopian-metrics.idea: An instrument with five scales, not a verdict: direct danger, Aesopian density, double-bottom index, insider legibility, legality.
aesopian-metrics.indicator: Asked for a reusable assessment rather than an opinion.
aesopian-metrics.rule: Return numbers, a table and one concrete improvement.

blindness-to-control-infrastructure.idea: Add the layer usually missed: formal procedures and a security function may be gathering information and documenting.
blindness-to-control-infrastructure.indicator: Review postponed, meeting missed, colleague withdrawn, questions about loyalty.
blindness-to-control-infrastructure.rule: A hypothesis with checks, not a conspiracy and not a coincidence.

authentic-expertise-vs-anxiety.idea: Politeness as reducing the risk of rejection vs usefulness as transferring structure.
authentic-expertise-vs-anxiety.indicator: Praise in the first lines of the answer.
authentic-expertise-vs-anxiety.rule: Remove the compliment: does any content remain?

macroeconomics-not-only-rigor.idea: Economic analysis of relations vs analysis of subjectivation; the second does not require the first.
macroeconomics-not-only-rigor.indicator: Every explanation is pushed to class position.
macroeconomics-not-only-rigor.rule: Where the theory runs out, say so instead of extending it.

power-vs-vector.idea: Power (capacity to influence and destroy) vs vector (where that capacity points).
power-vs-vector.indicator: A strong subordinate is read as a threat.
power-vs-vector.rule: Ask what he gains from preserving the current structure.
